resources.string: Ifomethi yesithombe esinyakazayo ayaziwa (hhayi izithombe ezinyakazayo ze-Google/OPPO/vivo/Xiaomi/Apple)
Ividiyo ilinkulu kakhulu (%1$dMB); akunakwenzeka ukuhlanganiswa ibe yisithombe esinyakazayo; khetha ividiyo emfushane
Emva kokushintsha, ividiyo ilinkulu kakhulu (%1$dMB); akunakwenzeka ukuhlanganiswa ibe yisithombe esinyakazayo
Ividiyo ilinkulu kakhulu (%1$dMB); akunakwenzeka ukuhlanganiswa ibe yisithombe esinyakazayo
Isithombe esingaphambili siyisithombe se-HEIC (inguqulo encane ayisekeli ukushintsha; khipha njengo-JPEG ku-iPhone bese uguqula)
Isithombe esingaphambili asisona isithombe esivumelekile (i-HEIC idinga ukuthi isistimu isekele ukufundwa kwe-HEIF)
Isithombe esingaphambili asisona isithombe se-JPEG (inguqulo encane ayisekeli ukushintsha; sebenzisa esikhundleni salo isithombe se-JPEG)
Isithombe esingaphambili asisona isithombe esivumelekile (kusekelwa kuphela i-JPEG/WebP/PNG)

Ividiyo “%1$s” %2$s; ukushintsha kuphela isiqukathi (ukupakisha kabusha) akushintshi ukukhoda, ngeke kwakheke isithombe esinyakazayo.\n\nKu-“Izilungiselelo → Ukushintsha ividiyo → Indlela yokushintsha” khetha “Phinda ukhode”, noma kuqala uguqule ngethuluzi elinye ibe yi-MP4 enokukhoda kwe-H.264/H.265.

Ividiyo ayikho esiqukathini se-MP4 esivamile (MOV / MKV / WebM / AVI nokunye), futhi “Indlela yokushintsha” yamanje ayikhodi kabusha, ngeke kwakheke isithombe esinyakazayo.\n\nKu-“Izilungiselelo → Ukushintsha ividiyo → Indlela yokushintsha” khetha “Phinda ukhode” (inguqulo evamile inesikhodi se-ffmpeg esakhelwe ngaphakathi; inguqulo encane ye-Go ayinawo isishintshi sevidiyo, sebenzisa inguqulo evamile), noma kuqala uguqule ividiyo ibe yi-MP4 esivamile (H.264/H.265).
Ifomethi yomthombo nefomethi yokukhishwa iyafana; ikhopiwe njengoba kunjalo (akulahleki lutho)
Ividiyo yomthombo inezitraki ezahlukile kumsindo nevidiyo (%1$s); kweqiwe ukudlulisa ngqo ngefomethi efanayo, kwalandelwa inqubo ephelele yokubhala ukuze kuhlanjwe
Umthombo awunalo uphawu lwesikhathi lwefreymu yesithombe esingaphambili; ngokomgomo kubuyiselwa endaweni esemaphakathi yevidiyo
Ividiyo inezitraki ezengeziwe (%1$s), alikwazi ukuhlanjwa, ikhishwe njengoba kunjalo (le mpumela ingase ingadlali ngokuchofoza okude kwezinye izinhlobo zamadivayisi)

Ividiyo yomthombo %1$s; ukupakisha kabusha isiqukathi kuphela akusonjululi (%2$s); uma le mpumela isingadlali ngokuchofoza okude, ku-“Izilungiselelo → Ukushintsha ividiyo → Indlela yokushintsha” khetha “Phinda ukhode”
Ividiyo yomthombo %1$s; ngokwezilungiselelo ikhodiwa kabusha ibe yi-8bit + AAC ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuvumelana ne-ialbamu
Impumela yokukhoda kabusha ayisebenzi, ikhishwe njengoba kunjalo (le mpumela ingase ingadlali ngokuchofoza okude kwezinye izinhlobo zamadivayisi)
Ukukhoda kabusha kwehlulekile (%1$s), ikhishwe njengoba kunjalo (le mpumela ingase ingadlali ngokuchofoza okude kwezinye izinhlobo zamadivayisi)
Isithombe esingaphambili siyi-HEIC (hhayi i-JPEG); saguqulwa ibe yi-JPEG esivamile bese sipakishwa kabusha
Isishintshi sevidiyo asivuliwe: kushintshwa kuphela ibhrendi yesiqukathi (MOV → MP4), akukhodiwa kabusha
Ividiyo iyashintshwa nge-ffmpeg ibe yi-MP4 esivamile (%1$s / crf %2$d / %3$s; kugcinwa kuphela izitraki zevidiyo nomsindo)
Isiqukathi sevidiyo siyapakishwa kabusha ibe yi-MP4 esivamile (kushintshwa kuphela isiqukathi, akukhodiwa kabusha)

Ividiyo elikhethiwe lidlula masekhondi angu-3; isithombe esinyakazayo esenziwe ngayo kungenzeka sinazo izinkinga zokuvumelana:

• Kungenzeka lingadlali kahle
• Kungenzeka i-ialbamu lesistimu ingasiboni
• Kwezinye izinhlobo zamadivayisi kungenzeka lingabonwa lesi sithombe esinyakazayo
Kule divayisi kusafakwe inguqulo endala (inguqulo ye-Go) yohlelo; le nguqulo endala ayisasebenzi kule divayisi, ungayisusa ukuze ukhulule isikhala.

Imodi yokubuyisela ibhala impumela yokuguqula ngqo kufayela lokuqala; uma ifayela lokuqala selibhalwe phezu kwayo, alitholakali kabusha.

• Ngesikhathi sokubhala, uma uhlelo luphazamiseka, uma isitoreji seliphelelwe yisikhala noma uma imvume ikhishiwe, ifayela lomthombo lingonakala
• Ukuguqula ngokwakho akukwazi ukuqinisekisa impumelelo ngokuphelele; uma kwehluleka, ifayela lomthombo kungenzeka selingasasebenzi
• Kwelulekwa ukuthi uqale uzame ngofayela owodwa noma amabili; uma uqinisekise ukuthi akunankinga, uqhubeke ngobuningi
• Izithombe ezibalulekile, wena wenzekela ikhophi yokugcina kuqala

Lo msebenzi unikezwa “njengoba kunjalo”; ingozi yokusetshenziswa ihlala kuwe, futhi umbhali akanasibopho ekonakaleni nasekalahlekeni kwamafayela.
